name: prototype
description: Turn a half-formed UI/flow idea into a faithful, clickable HTML mock in the target product's own look — before you know the flow. mockup clones the real status-quo page and applies only the change you want (composing from the design system only for net-new surfaces), declares its fidelity basis in a toggleable overlay, and emits one self-contained file. A facsimile of the product, not a document about it. General-purpose — no spec or tracker coupling.
